title: Schedule of Cancellation Terms — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
# Schedule of Cancellation Terms

This schedule sets out the figures and switches each Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans tier carries for cancellation refunds, refund payment and expiry.

## Refund figures by plan

| Plan | Free look (calendar days after sale date) | Refund method after the free look | Retail value per redeemed visit (USD) | Cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit | 30 | Retail-value deduction | 99.95 | 50.00 |
| Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit | 30 | Retail-value deduction | 104.95 | 50.00 |
| Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit | 30 | Retail-value deduction | 119.95 | 50.00 |
| Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit | 60 | Retail-value deduction | 124.95 | 75.00 |
| Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit | 60 | Retail-value deduction | 139.95 | 75.00 |
| Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit | 30 | Pro rata unused visits | 94.95 | 25.00 |

Under the retail-value deduction method, the retail value per visit is deducted for each redeemed visit. Under the pro rata unused visits method, the refund follows the share of visits left unused.

## Switches common to every plan

| Term | Every Kessler Care plan |
|---|---|
| Cancellation fee waived when the vehicle is a total loss | Yes |
| Plan sold on a purchase deal that is unwound refunded in full | Yes |
| Refund on a plan financed on the installment contract paid to the lienholder | Yes |
| Refund paid within this many calendar days after the cancellation is processed | 30 |
| Negative computed refund billed to the holder | No |
| Visits unused at expiration refunded | No |

## Notes

- The Plus 8-Visit and Premium 10-Visit tiers have a 60-day free look and a 75.00 fee. The other retail tiers have a 30-day free look and a 50.00 fee. The Fleet tier has a 30-day free look and a 25.00 fee.
- No tier refunds visits left unused when the plan expires, and no tier bills a holder when a computed refund falls below zero.
